items.title: Balancing CO2 Mass Transport and Salt Precipitation via Multiparameter Optimization for Efficient Syngas Production in MEA Electrolyzers
items.authors: Pan Huang, Shaojie Zheng, Xuefeng He, Hao Lei, Zhenting Xie, Qin Peng et al.
items.summary: Abstract Electrochemical CO2 reduction (eCO2RR) offers a sustainable route for converting CO2 into value-added chemicals and fuels, yet its practical application is hindered by CO2 transport limitations and salt precipitation in membrane electrode assembly (MEA) electrolyzers. In this work, we systematically investigated the effects of catalyst loading, gas diffusion layer (GDL) wettability, CO2 flow rate, CO2 temperature, and acid-vapor humidification on the eCO2RR performance. By systematically balancing electrode kinetics, CO2 mass transport, and salt precipitation, an optimal combination of operating conditions for the MEA-based eCO2RR is identified: catalyst loading of 1.0 mg cm–2,…
